packageRules.description: Everything automerges once CI is green (D-97) except a major: a green build can still hide a behaviour change, so a person reads the release notes first.
compose.yaml, compose.dev.yaml and ci.yml pin the same TimescaleDB image, and the Kubernetes deployment mirrors it (docs/OPERATIONS.md §9): bump all three in one PR so they cannot drift.
The Dockerfile stays on node:24: corepack is not shipped with Node 25+ (TOOL-6). Minor and patch updates still come through.
